Maria: Heads up — customer SCIM provisioning failing when Okta truncates attributes to use a literal ellipsis (U+2026) in external_id. Provisioner errors out.
Devin: Are we sure it's U+2026 vs three ASCII dots? That changes byte sequence used in KMS AAD.
Maria: Confirmed. Log: 
2026-04-10T15:12:09Z scim-provisioner ERROR user_create id=9823 external_id="j.smith…@acme.com" err="kms:Decrypt failed: envelope header mismatch"
Elaine: Which IdP?
Maria: Okta. Looks like when AD-sourced attr >64 chars Okta shows truncated value with U+2026.
Ashok: Problem: we include external_id in KMS encryption context. Any change in byte representation -> unwrap fails.
Samir: We thought context was tenant+key_version only. If external_id is used for per-entity wrapping that's brittle.
Devin: Short term: implement fallback unwrap behavior: try full context, then try replacing U+2026 with three dots, then try dropping external_id. Emit metric scim.kms.unwrap_fallback.
Ashok: Agreed but must log each fallback and alert if rate >1% over 5m.
Samir: Long term: canonical_external_id column and deterministic normalization (NFKC + map ellipsis to '...'). Use canonical for crypto only. Backfill and rewrap affected envelopes.
Maria: I'll open INC-2026-0423 and draft runbook. Assignments: Maria incident + runbook, Ashok fallback prototype, Devin DB migration + rewrap job, Samir KMS policy review.
devops-accounts: Pinged Okta SE for payload samples; they requested logs.
Maria: Metrics to watch: scim.provision.failures.kms_decrypt, scim.kms.unwrap_fallback, idp.attribute.ellipsis.count.
Devin: I'll prototype a 10-envelope rewrap for QA tomorrow morning (canary).
